arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT "config" AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT "pending", b.booking_id, json_object("request_id",b.request_id,"flight",b.flight_id,"passenger",b.passenger_id,"amount",b.amount_cents,"reference",b.client_reference,"charges",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("id",c.charge_id,"key",c.idempotency_key,"state",c.state,"amount",c.amount_cents,"step",c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status="pending" UNION ALL SELECT "outbox",event_id,json_object("booking",booking_id,"payload",payload,"status",status,"attempts",attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status<>"delivered" UNION ALL SELECT "cancel",request_id,json_object("step",step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT "flight",flight_id,json_object("price",price_cents,"capacity",capacity,"version",version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT "cache",key,value FROM cache

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'pending', b.booking_id, json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',request_id,json_object('step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'capacity',capacity,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache

SELECT 'pending' kind,b.booking_id id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'cancel',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'related',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',d.booking_id,'status',d.status)) FROM bookings d WHERE d.client_reference=b.client_reference AND d.booking_id<>b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',o.event_id,json_object('booking',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'booking_status',b.status,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'reference',b.client_reference) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON o.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'fare',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config

SELECT 'pending' kind,b.booking_id id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled',b.booking_id,json_object('cancel_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charged',(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents),0) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured'),'refunded',(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents),0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'audit','confirmed_missing_backing',json_object('count',count(*)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id)<>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'audit','duplicate_sales',json_object('count',count(*)) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'audit','capacity_excess',json_object('count',count(*)) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity
